header.tagline: Electrical & Computer Engineering student building practical solutions to interesting problems.

paragraphs: I am a final-year BSc (Eng) Electrical and Computer Engineering student at the University of Cape Town, expecting to complete my degree in December 2026. My current final-year average is 80.65%, and I was named on the Dean's List in my third year.

My interests include practical engineering design, AI and automation, embedded systems, computer vision, biomedical engineering and machine learning models. I hold British and South African citizenship and will be available for work from January 2027.
Outside of engineering, I play water polo, participate in social squash and enjoy a good cup of coffee.

items.name: TumorTrace — AI Medical Imaging Venture
description: Created a medtech company and product concept called TumorTrace through the EDHE Entrepreneurial Competition.
Developed an AI-based approach to identify tumours in medical images and classify them as malignant or benign.
Created an algorithm to take the dimensions of the tumours, removing any error from the images
Applied machine-learning and medical-imaging concepts to a practical diagnostic-support problem.

items.name: Micromouse — Autonomous Maze-Solving Robot
description: Designed and developed a Micromouse robot capable of navigating and solving a maze autonomously.
Integrated embedded hardware, sensors, motor control and software to support real-time navigation.
Applied principles of control systems, embedded programming and algorithmic problem solving.

items.name: Power Board PCB Design
description: Designed, simulated and tested a power-management printed circuit board (PCB) for an embedded electronics application.
Developed the circuit schematic and PCB layout in KiCad, with attention to power distribution, component placement, grounding and board-level design constraints.
Designed the board to provide battery monitoring, pump-control circuitry, and regulated 3.3 V and 5 V DC power rails.
Prioritised low-noise power delivery to support reliable, high-quality sensor data acquisition.
Verified individual circuit functions through SPICE simulations before testing the assembled hardware upon manufacture.
Developed practical experience in power electronics, PCB design, hardware validation and embedded-system integration.

items.name: AI-Assisted Job Search Tool
description: Developed an AI-assisted webscraper tool to improve and streamline the job-search process.
Used AI workflows to help identify relevant opportunities, organise job-search information and support tailored applications.
Combined software development, automation and practical user-focused problem solving.

items.name: Laser-Based Listening Device — Final-Year Thesis
description: Current final-year Electrical and Computer Engineering thesis project investigating a laser-based listening device.
Exploring optical sensing methods that recover audio-related vibration information from a distant surface.
Combines optics, analogue and digital signal processing, embedded systems and experimental engineering design.

items.name: Automated Cable Schedule Generation
description: Built a MATLAB script during vacation work at HATCH Engineering to automate cable-schedule generation.
The script supported the cooling-tower region of a platinum mine project in Zimbabwe.
Received an award for this automation work; also contributed to load lists and lighting diagrams.

items.name: Portfolio Website
description: A responsive engineering portfolio built with vanilla JavaScript and JSON-driven content.
Includes dynamic content loading, GitHub integration and dark/light mode support.
Designed as a central place for technical projects, experience and code repositories.

responsibilities: Completed six weeks of vacation work at the HATCH Engineering offices in Johannesburg.
Developed an award-winning MATLAB script to automate cable-schedule generation for a platinum-mine cooling tower in Zimbabwe.
Created load lists and lighting diagrams for engineering deliverables.
Tutored EEE3089F: Electromagnetic Engineering focusing on antena design and basic radar physics.
Tutored MEC1003F: Engineering Drawing which taught students how to create PCBs using KiCAD
Coached the U14A and U15A boys' water polo teams.
Helped the teams achieve gold at a local schools tournament.
